notes: Initial release: search + tag filter, Settings page (theming controls), and the Claude dev panel.

Settings moved from a separate page into a non-blocking left-side panel (live-tunable alongside the Claude panel, which moved to the right and also no longer dims the page). Added a left category sidebar for browsing prompts.

Settings panel moved to the right (same side as the Claude panel); the two are now mutually exclusive, only one open at a time. Added a mobile-preview button (phone icon) showing the site in a device frame, with the device itself a setting.

Mobile preview is no longer a framed overlay — the phone icon now narrows the real page to the chosen device's width (via a @container query instead of @media), reflowing the live, interactive site. Icon swaps to a desktop glyph while active and moved to the left of Settings.
